name: @akurganow/model-router
description: Routes subagents to a model and effort that fits the task, judged by Jev. One package for OpenClaw and Oh My Pi.

provider.description: Whose model scores each task. typesafe: Jev from TypeSafe, the model the plugin's questions are fitted to.

gateway.description: How OpenRouter is used to reach the provider. direct: the provider's own API only. auto: the provider's own API, then OpenRouter if it fails. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then the provider's own API if it fails. openrouter: OpenRouter only. With auto or openrouter-first and both keys set, one task may reach both companies.

scope.description: Which subagents are routed. core: the task agent only. extended: every agent whose model you did not set, bundled agents included.
